name: heimdall
description: Local OpenAI-compatible model router with vendor failover.
author: tang

scripts.check: node --check src/config.js && node --check src/runtime-config.js && node --check src/logger.js && node --check src/openai-protocol.js && node --check src/router-urls.js && node --check src/usage.js && node --check src/usage-store.js && node --check src/vendor-circuit-breaker.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check gui/electron/config-store.js && node --check gui/electron/ipc-contracts.js && node --check gui/electron/log-store.js && node --check gui/electron/main.js && node --check gui/electron/tray-controller.js && node --check gui/electron/updater.js && node --check gui/electron/preload.cjs && node --check gui/src/app-controllers.js && node --check gui/src/app-model.js && node --check gui/src/config-draft.js && node --check gui/src/desktop-api.js && node --check scripts/start-electron-dev.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-release-notes.mjs && node --check test/openai-protocol.test.js && node --check test/usage.test.js && node --check test/vendor-circuit-breaker.test.js && node --check test/electron-lifecycle.test.js && node --check test/ipc-contracts.test.js
scripts.test: node test/config-and-urls.test.js && node test/config-draft.test.js && node test/ipc-contracts.test.js && node test/log-store.test.js && node test/openai-protocol.test.js && node test/usage.test.js && node test/vendor-circuit-breaker.test.js && node test/fallback-smoke.test.js
scripts.dist:windows: npm run electron:install && npm run icons:build && npm run gui:build && node scripts/prepare-electron-builder.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:windows:dir: npm run electron:install && npm run icons:build && npm run gui:build && node scripts/prepare-electron-builder.mjs && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons:build && npm run gui:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal
scripts.dist:mac:dir: npm run icons:build && npm run gui:build && electron-builder --mac dir --universal
